title.en: Bones, Muscles, and Joints of Arms, Hands, Legs, and Feet
title.zh: 手臂、手、腿和脚的骨骼、肌肉与关节

sourceBook: Milady Standard Nail Technology 8th Edition + Milady Standard Foundations (2020)

question.en: The uppermost and largest bone of the arm is the
question.zh: 手臂最上面、最大的骨头是

explanation.en: The humerus is the uppermost and largest bone of the arm. It runs from the elbow to the shoulder.
explanation.zh: humerus（肱骨）是手臂最上面、最大的骨头，从肘部一直延伸到肩部。

lockPoint.en: Humerus is Latin for shoulder or upper arm. In Chinese, 肱 in 肱骨 also means upper arm.
lockPoint.zh: humerus 是拉丁语的“肩、上臂”。中文“肱骨”的“肱”也是上臂的意思。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Bones of the Arms and Hands

evidence.quote: Humerus (HYOO-muh-rus). The uppermost and largest bone of the arm, extending from the elbow to the shoulder.

question.en: Which bone is larger at the elbow than at the wrist?
question.zh: 哪块骨头肘部一端比腕部一端粗？

explanation.en: The ulna is the longer bone of the forearm. It is larger at the elbow than at the wrist and sits on the little-finger side of the hand.
explanation.zh: ulna（尺骨）是前臂较长的骨头，肘部一端比腕部一端粗，位于手的小指一侧。

lockPoint.en: Ulna is Latin for elbow or arm. Feel the point of your elbow: that knob is the ulna.
lockPoint.zh: ulna 是拉丁语的“肘、手臂”。摸摸你手肘尖：那个骨突就是尺骨。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Bones of the Arms and Hands

evidence.quote: Ulna (UL-nuh). The longer bone of the forearm. It is larger at the elbow than at the wrist and is located on the little finger side of the hand.

question.en: The forearm bone on the thumb side is the
question.zh: 前臂位于拇指一侧的骨头是

explanation.en: The radius is the shorter of the two forearm bones. It is largest at the wrist and lies on the thumb side of the hand.
explanation.zh: radius（桡骨）是前臂两根骨头中较短的一根，腕部一端最粗，位于手的拇指一侧。

lockPoint.en: The radial nerve and radial artery also run on the thumb side. Take a wrist pulse there.
lockPoint.zh: radial nerve（桡神经）和 radial artery（桡动脉）也在拇指一侧。在手腕拇指侧就能摸到脉搏。

question.en: The carpus, or wrist, is made up of how many bones?
question.zh: carpus（腕部，即手腕）由几块骨头组成？

explanation.en: The carpus is the wrist: a flexible joint of eight small, irregular bones held together by ligaments.
explanation.zh: carpus（腕骨）就是手腕：由八块不规则的小骨头组成、靠韧带连接的灵活关节。

lockPoint.en: Wrist: 8 carpals, in two rows of four. Foot: 7 tarsals. Don't swap the two numbers.
lockPoint.zh: 手腕：8 块腕骨，排成两排、每排四块。脚：7 块跗骨（tarsals）。这两个数字别记混。

evidence.quote: Carpus (KAR-pus). The wrist: a flexible joint composed of a group of eight small, irregular bones held together by ligaments.
These can be subdivided into three general categories: seven tarsal (TAHR-sul) bones

question.en: The bones of the palm of the hand are the
question.zh: 手掌的骨头是

explanation.en: The metacarpus forms the palm: five bones between the wrist bones and the finger bones.
explanation.zh: metacarpus（掌骨）是手掌的骨头：位于腕骨和手指骨之间的五块骨头。

lockPoint.en: Meta = after or beyond (Greek). Meta-carpus = the bones just beyond the wrist.
lockPoint.zh: meta = 在……之后、超出（希腊语）。meta-carpus 就是“腕骨之后”的骨头。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Bones of the Arms and Hands

evidence.quote: Metacarpus (met-uh-KAR-pus). Bones of the palm of the hand; parts of the hand containing five bones between the carpus and phalanges.

question.en: The bones of the fingers and toes are called
question.zh: 手指和脚趾的骨头叫什么？

explanation.en: Phalanges are the bones of the fingers or toes, also called digits. Each foot has 14 of them.
explanation.zh: phalanges（指骨/趾骨）是手指或脚趾的骨头，也叫 digits。每只脚有 14 块。

lockPoint.en: A phalanx was a line of Greek soldiers standing in rows. Finger bones line up the same way.
lockPoint.zh: phalanx 是古希腊排成一列列的士兵方阵。手指骨也是这样一节一节排成行。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Bones of the Arms and Hands
Anatomy - Bones of the Leg, Ankle, and Foot

evidence.quote: Phalanges (fuh-LAN-jeez). Bones of the fingers or toes, or digits.
14 bones called phalanges, which compose the toes

question.en: Muscles that straighten the wrist, hand, and fingers are the
question.zh: 把手腕、手和手指伸直的肌肉是

explanation.en: Extensors straighten the wrist, hand, and fingers to form a straight line. Flexors are involved in bending the wrist.
explanation.zh: extensors（伸肌）把手腕、手和手指伸直成一条线。flexors（屈肌）参与弯曲手腕。

lockPoint.en: Extend your arm and it goes straight; flex your arm and it bends. Same idea at the wrist.
lockPoint.zh: extend 手臂就是把它伸直，flex 手臂就是把它弯起来。手腕也是同样道理。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Muscles of the Shoulder and Arm

evidence.quote: Extensors (eks-STEN-sors). Muscles that straighten the wrist, hand, and fingers to form a straight line.
involved in bending the wrist

question.en: The larger of the two bones below the knee is the
question.zh: 膝盖下方两根骨头中较大的一根是

explanation.en: The tibia is the larger bone of the lower leg. You can see it as the bump on the big-toe side of the ankle.
explanation.zh: tibia（胫骨）是小腿较大的骨头，在脚踝大脚趾一侧凸起的那个骨包就是它。

lockPoint.en: The tibia is your shinbone: the hard front edge you bump on furniture.
lockPoint.zh: 胫骨就是小腿前面的“迎面骨”：常撞到家具的那条硬边。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Bones of the Leg, Ankle, and Foot

evidence.quote: The tibia (TIB-ee-ah) is the larger of the two bones that form the leg below the knee. The tibia may be visualized as a bump on the big-toe side of the ankle.

question.en: Which muscle bends the foot up?
question.zh: 哪块肌肉把脚往上勾？

explanation.en: The extensor digitorum longus bends the foot up and extends the toes. The soleus and peroneus brevis bend the foot down; the abductor hallucis moves the big toe.
explanation.zh: extensor digitorum longus（趾长伸肌）把脚往上勾并伸展脚趾。比目鱼肌和腓骨短肌把脚往下压；踇展肌活动大脚趾。

lockPoint.en: Read the name: extensor = straightens, digitorum = of the digits (toes), longus = long.
lockPoint.zh: 看名字就懂：extensor = 伸，digitorum = 趾，longus = 长。中文“趾长伸肌”正好一一对应。

Anatomy - Muscles of the Lower Leg and Foot

evidence.quote: The extensor digitorum longus (eck-STEN-sur dih-jit-TOHR-um LONG-us) bends the foot up and extends the toes.
It bends the foot down and out.
originates at the upper portion of the fibula and bends the foot down
The abductor hallucis (ab-DUK-tohr ha-LU-sis) moves the great toe

question.en: Which foot bone forms the ankle joint with the tibia and fibula?
question.zh: 哪块足骨与胫骨、腓骨一起组成踝关节？

explanation.en: The ankle joint is made of three bones: the tibia and fibula from the leg, and the talus, or ankle bone, of the foot.
explanation.zh: 踝关节由三块骨头组成：来自小腿的胫骨和腓骨，以及足部的 talus（距骨，即踝骨）。

lockPoint.en: Talus is Latin for ankle bone. It sits right under the tibia and carries the body's weight.
lockPoint.zh: talus 是拉丁语的“踝骨”。它就在胫骨正下方，承接全身的重量。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Bones of the Leg, Ankle, and Foot

evidence.quote: The ankle joint is made up of three bones
The talus (TA-lus), or ankle bone, of the foot.

question.en: The heavy, long bone that forms the leg above the knee is the
question.zh: 构成膝盖以上腿部的又重又长的骨头是

explanation.en: The femur is a heavy, long bone that forms the leg above the knee. The tibia and fibula form the leg below the knee.
explanation.zh: femur（股骨）是构成膝盖以上腿部的又重又长的骨头。胫骨和腓骨构成膝盖以下的小腿。

lockPoint.en: Femur is Latin for thigh. Nail technicians may serve the leg only below the knee.
lockPoint.zh: femur 是拉丁语的“大腿”。美甲师只能为膝盖以下的腿部提供服务。

feet, and legs (below the knee)

question.en: Which is an example of an immovable joint?
question.zh: 下列哪一个是不动关节的例子？

explanation.en: Joints connect bones. Movable joints include elbows, knees, and hips; immovable joints, like the skull or pelvis, allow little or no movement.
explanation.zh: 关节连接骨头。可动关节包括肘、膝、髋；不动关节，例如颅骨或骨盆，几乎不能活动。

lockPoint.en: The bones around the brain meet at zigzag seams that interlock like puzzle pieces.
lockPoint.zh: 包住大脑的颅骨靠锯齿状的骨缝像拼图一样咬合在一起。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Skeletal System
Anatomy - Skeletal System

evidence.quote: There are two types of joints: movable, such as elbows,
knees, and hips; and immovable, such as the pelvis or skull, which allows little or no movement.

question.en: The part of a muscle that does not move is the
question.zh: 肌肉中不动的部分叫什么？

explanation.en: The origin is the fixed part of a muscle attached to the skeleton. The insertion is where more movement occurs, and the belly is the middle.
explanation.zh: origin（起点）是肌肉固定、附着在骨骼上的部分。insertion（止点）是活动较多的地方，belly（肌腹）是中间部分。

lockPoint.en: Origin = where it starts, like an anchor. In massage, pressure usually moves from insertion toward origin.
lockPoint.zh: origin = 起点，像锚一样固定。按摩时，压力通常从止点推向起点。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Muscular System

evidence.quote: The origin (OR-ah-jin) is the part that does not move; it is attached to the skeleton
Pressure in massage is usually directed from the insertion to the origin

question.en: Muscles that separate the fingers are the
question.zh: 把手指分开的肌肉是

explanation.en: Abductors separate the fingers. Adductors, at the base of each finger, draw the fingers together.
explanation.zh: abductors（外展肌）把手指分开。adductors（内收肌）位于每根手指根部，把手指并拢。

lockPoint.en: Ab = away (as in absent); ad = toward (as in add). Abductors move fingers away from each other.
lockPoint.zh: ab = 离开（absent 缺席）；ad = 朝向（add 加上）。外展肌让手指彼此分开。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Muscles of the Hand

evidence.quote: Abductors (ab-DUK-turz). Muscles that separate the fingers.
Adductors (ah-DUK-turz). Muscles at the base of each finger that draw the fingers together.

question.en: Which muscles turn the hand inward so the palm faces down?
question.zh: 哪种肌肉让手向内转、掌心朝下？

explanation.en: Pronators turn the hand inward so the palm faces down. The supinator rotates the radius outward so the palm faces up.
explanation.zh: pronators（旋前肌）让手向内转、掌心朝下。supinator（旋后肌）让桡骨向外转、掌心朝上。

lockPoint.en: Lying prone = face down; lying supine = face up. The palm follows the same rule.
lockPoint.zh: 英文 prone = 脸朝下趴着，supine = 脸朝上躺着。掌心朝向也按这个规则记。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Muscles of the Shoulder and Arm

evidence.quote: Pronators (PRO-nay-tors). Muscles that turn the hand inward so that the palm faces downward.
Supinator (SOO-puh-nayt-er). Muscle of the forearm that rotates the radius (forearm) outward and the palm upward.

question.en: The large triangular muscle covering the shoulder joint is the
question.zh: 覆盖肩关节的大块三角形肌肉是

explanation.en: The deltoid is a large, triangular muscle over the shoulder joint. It lets the arm extend outward and to the side of the body.
explanation.zh: deltoid（三角肌）是覆盖肩关节的大块三角形肌肉，让手臂向外、向身体侧面抬起。

lockPoint.en: Named for delta (Δ), the Greek letter shaped like a triangle. A river delta has the same shape.
lockPoint.zh: 名字来自希腊字母 delta（Δ），形状就是三角形。河流三角洲（delta）也是这个形状。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Muscles of the Shoulder and Arm

evidence.quote: Deltoid (DEL-toyd). Large, triangular muscle covering the shoulder joint that allows the arm to extend outward and to the side of the body.

question.en: Which nerve supplies the little-finger side of the arm and palm?
question.zh: 哪条神经支配手臂和手掌的小指一侧？

explanation.en: The ulnar nerve and its branches affect the little-finger side of the arm and palm of the hand, the same side as the ulna bone.
explanation.zh: ulnar nerve（尺神经）及其分支支配手臂和手掌的小指一侧，与尺骨在同一侧。

lockPoint.en: Bump your "funny bone" and your little finger tingles: that is the ulnar nerve at the elbow.
lockPoint.zh: 撞到手肘的“麻筋”，小指会发麻：那就是肘部的尺神经。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Nerves of the Arm and Hand

evidence.quote: Ulnar nerve (UL-nur NURV). With its branches, affects the little finger side of the arm and palm of the hand

question.en: Which nerve supplies skin on the outer side and back of the foot?
question.zh: 哪条神经支配足部外侧和后面的皮肤？

explanation.en: The sural nerve supplies the skin on the outer side and back of the foot and leg. The saphenous nerve supplies the inner side.
explanation.zh: sural nerve（腓肠神经）支配足部和小腿外侧及后面的皮肤。saphenous nerve（隐神经）支配内侧。

lockPoint.en: Sura is Latin for calf. The Chinese 腓肠 also means calf: the nerve runs down the back of it.
lockPoint.zh: sura 是拉丁语“小腿肚”。中文“腓肠”也是小腿肚的意思：这条神经沿小腿肚后面往下走。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Nerves of the Lower Leg and Foot

evidence.quote: The sural nerve (SUR-ul NURV) supplies impulses to the skin on the outer side and back of the foot and leg
The saphenous nerve (sa-FEEN-us NURV) supplies impulses to the skin of the inner side of the leg and foot.

question.en: Which artery supplies the foot with blood?
question.zh: 哪条动脉为足部供血？

explanation.en: The dorsalis pedis artery supplies the foot with blood. It continues from the anterior tibial artery, which runs down the lower leg.
explanation.zh: dorsalis pedis artery（足背动脉）为足部供血，它由沿小腿下行的胫前动脉（anterior tibial artery）延续而来。

lockPoint.en: Pedis = of the foot (pedicure); dorsalis = back, the top. Feel its pulse on top of the foot.
lockPoint.zh: pedis = 足的（pedicure 足部护理），dorsalis = 背面，指脚背。在脚背上能摸到它的脉搏。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Blood Supply to the Lower Leg and Foot

evidence.quote: The dorsalis pedis artery (dor-SAHL-is PEE-dis AR-tuh-ree) supplies the foot with blood.
This artery goes to the foot and becomes the dorsalis pedis artery.

question.en: Which muscle attaches to the back of the heel and pulls the foot down?
question.zh: 哪块肌肉附着在脚跟后方、把脚往下拉？

explanation.en: The gastrocnemius is attached to the lower rear surface of the heel and pulls the foot down. The tibialis anterior, on the front of the shin, bends the foot upward.
explanation.zh: gastrocnemius（腓肠肌）附着在脚跟后下方，把脚往下拉。胫骨前肌（tibialis anterior）在小腿前面，把脚往上勾。

lockPoint.en: Greek gaster = belly, kneme = leg: the "belly of the leg," the bulge of your calf.
lockPoint.zh: 希腊语 gaster = 肚子，kneme = 小腿：“小腿的肚子”，就是小腿肚鼓起的那块。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Muscles of the Lower Leg and Foot

evidence.quote: The gastrocnemius (gas-truc-NEE-mee-us) is attached to the lower rear surface of the heel and pulls the foot down.
The tibialis anterior (tib-ee-AHL-is an-TEER-ee-or) covers the front of the shin. It bends the foot upward and inward.
